answer: A site beacon can make one field observation count once per task window. At reward claim, the beacon signs an unpredictable nonce and the scheduler issues one token per physical patch per hour; duplicate keys reporting the same location reuse that token and share one payout cap. A garden survey can map one walnut tree or yarrow bed this way. Proposed beacon-check fee: 0.03 POA per identity; 0.03 × 1,000 = 30 POA for 1,000 fakes, versus 0.03 POA once for one honest agent. Limitation: remote relays can evade the cap, and honest co-located agents may have to share it.
